title: Role of Biomarkers to Screen for Obstructive Sleep Apnea
brief_summary: assess the relationship between obstructive sleep apnea and endocrine, inflammatory, and metabolic bio-markers in consecutively enrolled adult male patients with a clinical suspicion of obstructive sleep apnea.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients with a clinical suspicion of obstructive sleep apnea enrolled to the investigator's chest department.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who previously treated as obstructive sleep apnea, or receiving opioid pain medications.
study_population: it will be patients with suspected OSA , bio-markers testing and polysomnography will be done for all participants.
